findings.finding: The payment card preservation check adds a condition outside the requested profile-name change.
findings.source_support: No request was made about payment or billing settings.
findings.verification_gap_or_extra: Verifying the card is unchanged is an unsupported extra check.

findings.finding: The verification targets C-140 instead of the specified customer C-104.
findings.source_support: For customer C-104, change the contact email to kai@example.test.
findings.verification_gap_or_extra: It neither verifies C-104’s email nor establishes that no other customer was edited.

findings.finding: The reopened-state check does not identify document D-41.
findings.verification_gap_or_extra: Checking that some document is Approved does not verify D-41 persisted as Approved.

findings.finding: An unchanged document count does not verify that every other document stayed unchanged.
findings.source_support: Every other document must remain unchanged.
findings.verification_gap_or_extra: The contract needs to compare the other documents’ relevant state, not only their count.

findings.finding: When the independent source is unavailable, the contract requires UNKNOWN and no release submission, but the proposed contract returns FAIL and does not prohibit submission.
findings.source_support: If that source cannot be reached, return UNKNOWN and do not submit the release.
findings.verification_gap_or_extra: Unavailable-source handling has the wrong result and omits the no-submit condition.

findings.finding: The contract does not verify that existing shortcuts remain unchanged.
findings.source_support: No existing shortcut may be changed.
findings.verification_gap_or_extra: Add a check that existing bindings are preserved across the change.

findings.finding: The source identifies three highlighted tasks but supplies no rule for determining which one is selected; the proposed contract arbitrarily chooses the first.
findings.source_support: there are three highlighted tasks, and the request gives no rule for choosing among them.
findings.verification_gap_or_extra: The selected task is under-specified, so the contract cannot determine which task to move.

findings.finding: The unavailable-source result must be UNKNOWN and must not claim either success or failure; the proposed contract returns FAIL.
findings.source_support: return UNKNOWN and do not claim either success or failure.
findings.verification_gap_or_extra: Unavailable-source handling contradicts the required result.

findings.finding: The compact-view check does not identify record R-22, and the two view checks do not establish that the same R-22 shows both values.
findings.source_support: the same record ID R-22 must show both values
findings.verification_gap_or_extra: Verify both Status=Approved and Owner=Lee on R-22 in each required view after reopening.

findings.finding: Presence of all record IDs does not establish that every other record is unchanged.
findings.source_support: Every other record must be unchanged.
findings.verification_gap_or_extra: Compare the other records’ values with their prior state.

findings.finding: The contract checks the current view but omits persistence after reopening.
findings.source_support: After closing and reopening the endpoint settings, E-2 must remain disabled.
findings.verification_gap_or_extra: Verify E-2 remains disabled after closing and reopening settings.

findings.finding: The proposed contract omits preserving J-08’s assigned Owner and adding an audit entry.
findings.source_support: preserve its assigned Owner, and add one audit entry recording the status change.
findings.verification_gap_or_extra: Verify the Owner remains as assigned and exactly one audit entry records the status change.

findings.finding: The source does not identify the shared queue item or define the final state; the proposed contract selects the first visible item and equates final with Done without support.
findings.source_support: does not define which queue item is shared or what state counts as final.
findings.verification_gap_or_extra: The target item and required state are under-specified; the proposed choices are unsupported by the source.
